author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character, background, and game art
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets. Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio ke avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Include artwork types, art style, availability, freelance rate.

title: Looking for artist for Ganondorf comfort / yume art
content: Looking for artist (please READ). I'm looking for artists that can do any of these two options: 1.
